title: EVT-Albert
description: An emotional-volitional training logger and analytics research prototype using fictional demonstration records. This deposit preserves a dated source snapshot of the implementation and documentation, with the limitations stated in the repository.
notes: MIT applies to the original code. The repository README supersedes the obsolete proprietary repository description. Synthetic training examples do not validate a psychological theory. Archival publication does not establish peer review, independent validation or production readiness.
